Simple Application Process

How to Achieve a Professional Clean

Prepare the Surface

Begin by removing loose dust and debris from the tile surface with a dry cloth or vacuum to ensure the cleaner can work directly on the soil.

Apply the Cleaner

Apply the cleaner directly to the soiled tile or grout area. For vertical surfaces, the formula will cling and begin to penetrate the buildup immediately.

Scrub and Rinse

Allow the product to sit for a brief period to dissolve grime, then scrub gently with a soft brush or sponge. Rinse thoroughly with clean water to reveal a spotless finish.

Answers to Common Cleaning Questions

What types of tile and stone surfaces is this Miracle Sealants cleaner safe to use on?
This cleaner is specifically formulated for porcelain and ceramic tile, as well as non-polished natural and engineered stone surfaces. It is designed to be safe and effective on these materials without causing etching or damage.
Is this cleaning solution safe for use around children and pets in my home?
Yes. The product is described as having no harsh chemicals and uses an abrasive action that is gentle on surfaces. It is also noted as environmentally friendly, making it suitable for regular household cleaning.
How should I apply this cleaner for the best results on tough soap scum?
For best results, apply the cleaner directly to the soiled area, allow it to cling and penetrate for a few minutes, then scrub gently with a soft brush or sponge. Finally, rinse thoroughly with clean water to remove all residue.
Can this product remove old, set-in stains from my tile grout lines?
The formula is designed to lift and dissolve grease, soap scum, dirt, stains, and scuffs. While highly effective on common household soils, it is not intended for heavy-duty industrial grime or permanent chemical stains.
Does this cleaner leave a residue or protective coating on the tile after rinsing?
No, this product is not a sealer or polish. It is a cleaning solution designed to remove contaminants from the surface of tile and stone. To protect and seal cleaned surfaces afterward, you would need a separate Miracle Sealants sealer product.
How much area can I clean with one quart-sized bottle of this product?
The quart-sized bottle provides ample cleaning solution for multiple cleaning sessions, depending on the severity of the grime and the square footage being treated. It is a concentrated formula suitable for both spot cleaning and larger areas.
